W: Stone and more stone. Holes punched through it everywhere, by someone in a hurry.
B: The open-hand banner. Someone has drawn a small crown on it in charcoal, and then scribbled it out.
e: The ladder back up to the drill yard.
b: A bunk. The blanket's still folded. Soldiers made their beds even on the last morning.
x: A heap of rubble. The ceiling came down here, long ago.
k: A candle on an iron stand. Rest here.
K: A great studded door. Behind it, very faintly: snoring.
It won't open for you yet. You'd need more strength behind you.
L: Scratched into a board: "The prince is hiding in the maze again."
M: Scratched small, low down, where a young soldier sat: "I miss my mum."
N: A note tucked into a boot: "If you're reading this, the fort fell and I didn't. Tell Marta I kept her fence straight."

objects.name: The Quartermaster
lines: HALT. Everything must be signed for.
Everything. Even the end of the world. Especially the end of the world.

answer: Sign here. And here. And here. Initial there.
(You sign. The ghost hands you nothing, very officially.)
The Drill Whistle's on back order. Five hundred years. Any day now.
The Baron's asleep behind the big door. Has been since the end. Took the good sofa, too.
Baron Plush. Lord of the court, once. Told everyone to rest before the war.
They rested. Then there wasn't a war. Then there wasn't anything.

lines: Under a loose stone below the scratched board: a Heart Piece, and a wooden soldier with its paint worn off.
